name: smwmusic-earthbound-megaton-walk
title: EarthBound - Megaton Walk
description:
A song in Earthbound that is mostly of sample of a Beatles song. This plays when Dungeon Man is with you.

For any 1.0.8 users, you will have to change a define on the top of the text file because this uses a 1.0.9+ exclusive command (Size will be 1D3 bytes)
